concerns.text: Task T004 creates `src/utils/logger.py` and `src/utils/timeout_wrapper.py`, but the implementation plan moves these utilities to `src/pipeline/logging_utils.py` and `src/pipeline/runtime_guard.py`. Consequently, the consumer task T005 (CLI) which expects the utilities at `src/utils/…` will not find them, breaking the producer‑consumer relationship.

Task T007 references the script path `code/src/extraction/fetch_prs.py`, while the plan defines the script at `src/extraction/fetch_prs.py`. This path mismatch means the producer script may not be invoked, leaving downstream task T008 without the required raw PR payloads.

Constitution Principle VII requires an analysis‑plan document (`analysis/plan.md`). The task list does not include a task (e.g., T017‑analysis_plan) that creates this artifact, so the required producer is missing.

Principle I mandates logging of the random seed for reproducibility, yet no task in the list creates or validates such a seed‑provenance log (e.g., a `seed provenance` task). This omission leaves a required artifact unproduced.
